test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All bulbs are lights.

Some lights are fans.

Conclusions:

(I) Some fans are bulbs.

(II) All bulbs are fans.
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/caf61e47b92644ea463f6d5e532eaa7ac4ccf817f9fc2a021c699e9a8d14509f.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some fans are bulbs → False (because no direct relationship given between fans and bulbs so it may be possible not defined)

II. All bulbs are fans → False (because no direct relationship given between fans and bulbs so it may be possible not defined)

So, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
